title.zh: Anthropic撼动IBM之后，OpenAI也拿出接近满分的COBOL迁移成绩
title.en: Anthropic撼动IBM之后，OpenAI也拿出接近满分的COBOL迁移成绩

current_state.zh: OpenAI reported that its GPT-6 series achieved up to 97.9% success on COBOL-to-modern-language migration with byte-identical outputs and open-sourced MultiLangBench, where GPT-6 Astra averaged 87.4% across 20-language SQLite-engine tasks.
